searchText: ^ FWIW I closed that PR as it's returning the receipt wrapped in an RLP but that's actually incorrect for non-legacy EIP-2718 transaction types. trying to run Nethermind using https://notes.ethereum.org/@launchpad/kiln#Nethermind and it's just perpetually waiting for peers; are those instructions still current?
